product_one_liner.value: SiMa.ai provides purpose-built machine-learning chips and software that help developers build and deploy physical-AI applications.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes purpose-built MLSoC hardware and software for accelerating physical-AI application development and deployment; the developer center establishes the developer audience: https://sima.ai/ and https://developer.sima.ai/

pricing_page.notes: The public Edgematic page has a Plans & Pricing section with Free and Premium tiers. Published numerical prices are not required by the question: https://sima.ai/edgematic

named_customers.notes: The industrial case study describes an unnamed customer. The named industrial stories combine customers and partners without establishing two named customers; partners were excluded as requested. The empty list therefore reflects insufficient named customer evidence, not an absence of customers: https://sima.ai/industrial-leader-case-study and https://sima.ai/industrial

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 245 employees as of September 30, 2026, which falls in the 201-500 band: https://tracxn.com/d/companies/simaai/__hrXbyBEFp-A08KOSB51lFFOxWAS7MJbrkfK_TATmjMo

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The official company description explicitly identifies San Jose as headquarters: https://sima.ai/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/SiMa.ai-Company-Description.pdf | hq_country: The company identifies its headquarters as San Jose, California, and its company profile specifies United States: https://sima.ai/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/SiMa.ai-Company-Description.pdf

founded_year.notes: SiMa.ai explicitly states that it was founded in 2018: https://sima.ai/press-release/sima-ai-secures-funds-and-readies-new-generative-edge-ai-platform

eng_blog.notes: Under the strict two-post requirement, only the MLSoC Modalix engineering deep dive was verified as both product-building content and authored by an engineer. Other technical posts did not establish qualifying engineer authorship, while the index also contains marketing and application material: https://sima.ai/category/blog and https://sima.ai/blog/an-engineering-deep-dive-on-sima-ai-mlsoc-modalix

public_docs.notes: The public developer center links hardware, software, examples, and documentation; individual public pages cover model execution and GenAI development: https://developer.sima.ai/, https://docs.sima.ai/, and https://developer.sima.ai/software/develop-apps/development-workflow/genai-model

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Official job sources list Sr. Engineer, AI/ML Apps Engineering and Principal Engineer, AI & ML Design Verification, both qualifying by title: https://jobs.jobvite.com/simaai/job/o7jxAfwh?fr=true&nl=1 and https://jobs.jobvite.com/simaai/job/oHtmAfwQ

model_provider.value: Gemma on Modalix MLSoC; Supertonic 3 as GenAI Studio's default text-to-speech engine.
model_provider.notes: SiMa.ai publicly demonstrates conversational AI using Gemma on Modalix and states that GenAI Studio uses Supertonic 3 as its default text-to-speech engine. OpenAI API compatibility was not treated as evidence of using OpenAI models: https://sima.ai/conversational-ai and https://community.sima.ai/t/palette-neat-v0-5-0-release/2036

compliance_certs.notes: The official quality-policy page exists but names none of SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS, supporting an empty list under the requested rule: https://sima.ai/quality-policy/

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The latest identified financing is explicitly called Series C by both the company and financing counsel: https://sima.ai/press-release/sima-ai-reaches-1-45b-valuation-with-500-million-in-total-funding-to-scale-physical-ai-in-humanoids-automotive-and-drones and https://www.fenwick.com/insights/experience/fenwick-represents-simaai-150m-series-c-financing | funding_date: Both the company announcement and financing counsel date the latest identified round September 28, 2026, yielding 2026-09: https://sima.ai/press-release/sima-ai-reaches-1-45b-valuation-with-500-million-in-total-funding-to-scale-physical-ai-in-humanoids-automotive-and-drones and https://www.fenwick.com/insights/experience/fenwick-represents-simaai-150m-series-c-financing | funding_amount_usd: The September 28, 2026 announcement specifies a $150 million round, distinct from cumulative funding. The financing counsel independently confirms that amount: https://sima.ai/press-release/sima-ai-reaches-1-45b-valuation-with-500-million-in-total-funding-to-scale-physical-ai-in-humanoids-automotive-and-drones and https://www.fenwick.com/insights/experience/fenwick-represents-simaai-150m-series-c-financing

raised_18mo.notes: The $150 million financing announced September 28, 2026 falls within the 18-month window starting May 9, 2025: https://sima.ai/press-release/sima-ai-reaches-1-45b-valuation-with-500-million-in-total-funding-to-scale-physical-ai-in-humanoids-automotive-and-drones

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: No qualifying SDR, BDR, sales/business-development representative, or account-executive title was found in the reviewed official open positions. The Sales & Revenue Operations manager role does not qualify under the specified title rules: https://jobs.jobvite.com/simaai?fr=false&nl=1 and https://jobs.jobvite.com/simaai/job/oLhfAfwB?fr=true&nl=1

launched_6mo.notes: Palette Neat 0.5.0 was released October 6, 2026, within the six-month window starting May 9, 2026. The release introduced substantive applications, including RF-DETR detection and segmentation, rather than only bug fixes or UI changes: https://community.sima.ai/t/palette-neat-v0-5-0-release/2036

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Young-Hun Kluge's profile lists a March 2026 start as Senior Vice President, Global Business Development Automotive at SiMa.ai, inside November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026: https://linkedin.com/in/young-hun-kluge-657a6a1

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The Sales & Revenue Operations posting explicitly requires maintaining Salesforce data, reporting, and forecasting, providing a direct internal-use signal: https://jobs.jobvite.com/simaai/job/oLhfAfwB?fr=true&nl=1 | crm_stack_signal.0: Salesforce is explicitly named as the system whose data and reporting the operations employee would maintain: https://jobs.jobvite.com/simaai/job/oLhfAfwB?fr=true&nl=1
